decisions.reason: A naval vessel lighting system involves substantial engineering, certification and long-term defence customer commitments, so dropping it would write off a major investment and break promises made to specialist customers.

The firm gave this second-generation interior luminaire its own launch page, a public commitment it has continued as a mention, and it fits the firm's core LED direction, so management will persist despite its lower visibility.
The firm is actively promoting this pendant luminaire in 2024 as one of its latest releases, a fresh public commitment that makes withdrawal very unlikely.

Although its sibling HMI searchlight was dropped, this marine searchlight remains listed and fits the firm's announced specialist marine range, so management can still attribute weak results to temporary causes and keep it.
